import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.003}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.003}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 32
D = 16
P = 12
HID = 24


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.enc = nn.Conv2d(7 + self.Z, D, 1)
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, D, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(2 * D, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(6 * P, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

        per = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
        shared = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        pos = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([per, shared, pos], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 7 + Z, Y, X)
        e = self.enc(inp).view(B, Z, D, Y, X)
        e = F.relu(e + self.ctx(f).unsqueeze(1))
        cm = e.flip(1).cummax(1).values.flip(1)
        h = torch.cat([e, cm], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 2 * D, Y, X)
        p = self.proj(h)

        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            pooled = torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1).reshape(B, Z, 3 * P, Y, X)
            below = torch.cat([torch.zeros_like(pooled[:, :1]), pooled[:, :-1]], dim=1)
            u = torch.cat([pooled, below], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 6 * P, Y, X)
            sc = out(F.relu(mix(u))).reshape(B, Z, Y, X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
D = 48
HEADS = 4
NLAYER = 2
P = 24
HID = 32


class AttnLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, h):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = h
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 2 * d), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(2 * d, d))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, Dm = x.shape
        hd = Dm // self.h
        qkv = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).view(B, N, 3, self.h, hd).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, Dm)
        x = x + self.o(y)
        return x + self.ff(self.n2(x))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        n = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, D, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 3, padding=1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, n, D) * 0.02)
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([AttnLayer(D, HEADS) for _ in range(NLAYER)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(D, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(dy * dx * P, HID, 1) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        f = F.relu(s + self.conv(s))
        t = f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        for layer in self.layers:
            t = layer(t)
        t = self.norm(t)
        fm = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        p = F.relu(self.proj(fm))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            cells = [q[:, :, i:i + Y, j:j + X] for i in range(dy) for j in range(dx)]
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat(cells, dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean(1), t.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
W = 32
NBLOCK = 3
RED = 8


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.g = nn.Linear(2 * c, c)

    def forward(self, x):
        gv = self.g(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        h = F.relu(self.c1(x) + gv[:, :, None, None])
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(h))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.npl = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(W) for _ in range(NBLOCK)])
        self.place = nn.Conv2d(W, self.nt, 3, padding=1)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(W, RED, 1)
        self.lin = nn.Linear(RED * int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X), self.npl)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lin.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lin.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        f = self.stem(obs)
        for b in self.blocks:
            f = b(f)
        pc = self.place(f).flatten(1)
        pl = self.lin(F.relu(self.red(f)).flatten(1))
        place = pc + pl
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
W = 32
NBLOCK = 2
D = 32
H = 4


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.g = nn.Linear(2 * c, c)

    def forward(self, x):
        gv = self.g(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        h = F.relu(self.c1(x) + gv[:, :, None, None])
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(h))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        n = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.npl = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(W) for _ in range(NBLOCK)])
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, n, W) * 0.02)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(W)
        self.emb = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.npl, D))
        self.wq = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.wk = nn.Linear(W, D)
        self.wv = nn.Linear(W, D)
        self.wo = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.we = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.hid = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.out = nn.Linear(D, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        f = self.stem(obs)
        for b in self.blocks:
            f = b(f)
        t = self.norm(f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos)
        N = t.shape[1]
        A = self.npl
        hd = D // H
        q = self.wq(self.emb).view(A, H, hd).permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
        k = self.wk(t).view(B, N, H, hd).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        v = self.wv(t).view(B, N, H, hd).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        ctx = torch.matmul(att, v).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, A, D)
        h = F.relu(self.wo(ctx) + self.we(self.emb).unsqueeze(0))
        h = F.relu(self.hid(h))
        place = self.out(h).squeeze(-1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

TR = 32
CTX = 16
H1 = 96
H2 = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        c = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(c, 48, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(48, TR, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(TR, TR, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(TR, CTX, 1)
        cu = c + CTX
        self.l1 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(dy * dx * cu, H1, 1) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.l2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H1, H2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H2, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.normal_(o.weight, std=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TR, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        t = self.trunk(obs)
        u = torch.cat([obs, F.relu(self.ctx(t))], dim=1)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), l1, l2, out in zip(self.fps, self.l1, self.l2, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(u, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            cells = [q[:, :, i:i + Y, j:j + X] for i in range(dy) for j in range(dx)]
            h = F.relu(l1(torch.cat(cells, dim=1)))
            h = F.relu(l2(h))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

TR = 24
CTX = 8
HW = 48


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        c = int(spec.in_channels)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.ky = max(a for a, b in fps) + 2
        self.kx = max(b for a, b in fps) + 2
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(c, 32, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, TR, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(TR, TR, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(TR, CTX, 1)
        self.win = nn.Conv2d(c + CTX, HW, (self.ky, self.kx))
        self.mid = nn.Conv2d(HW, HW, 1)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(HW, int(spec.n_types), 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.out.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TR, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        t = self.trunk(obs)
        u = torch.cat([obs, F.relu(self.ctx(t))], dim=1)
        q = F.pad(u, (1, self.kx - 2, 1, self.ky - 2))
        h = F.relu(self.win(q))
        h = F.relu(self.mid(h))
        place = self.out(h).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting network scored 0.000 on both seeds, so nothing it learned shows up in exact builds. The default recipe is a likely cause. 131k steps split into updates of 256×16 samples gives only 32 policy updates, and an entropy weight of 0.01 spread over about 1,000 actions may keep the policy too random for exact builds. So this round tests the recipe on the unchanged network: more, smaller updates and fewer epochs, which also buys more samples. The structural problem is that a brick lands on the highest filled cell under its footprint, and it is correct only if every cell at that landing layer is in the target. The starting head pools 2D features with no idea of layers. My new idea is a head that scores each layer separately and is shared across layers. Each layer also gets a running max of features from that layer up, which marks occupancy at or above it, and the head looks at the layer below too. Everything is computed after learned layers, so nothing is hand-written.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success in the last 10% of training. That includes the default recipe, 2-epoch and 1-epoch PPO (243k and 426k samples), and an explicit per-layer landing head. Because training success is also zero, the problem is not generalisation: the agent never learns to build exactly. Changing the sample count, update count or entropy did not help. One reason may be that all three runs took about the same number of gradient steps (roughly 1,900 to 3,300). Two other gaps are untested. First, the trunk sees only a 5x5 neighbourhood and has no global context in its per-cell features, so it cannot tell which layer or overhang to work on next. Second, max/min/avg pooling over the footprint loses which cell is which, and an overhang check needs that. This round tests heavy sample reuse (more gradient steps), a deeper trunk with global context fed into each cell, and attention plus a head that keeps the footprint cells separate.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0. That includes training success, which counts stochastic rollouts. Recipe changes (1, 2 or 8 epochs, entropy 0.003 or 0.01, 65k to 408k steps) and trunk changes (deeper FiLM CNN, attention, a per-layer head) made no difference. A per-step task with a dense reward should give some exact builds if the network's assumptions match the world. Every trial so far shares one assumption: logits come from footprint pooling anchored at the top-left, in type-major order. The note says the world may differ from its description. If the anchor, the index order or the x/y axes differ, that head scores the wrong cells, and no trunk or recipe change can fix it. This round tests heads that rely less on the stated action layout. Each one adds less of this structural prior than the last: a 3x3 conv head plus a free linear head; a pure MLP; and learned action queries attending over cells. The recipe is fixed at 2 epochs and 128 envs so the results compare networks only.
analyses.4: All nine trials scored 0 on both seeds and 0 on training success. That covers several recipes (1 to 8 epochs, 65k to 407k steps) and several networks (pooled heads, a per-layer head, a FiLM ResNet, attention, a 3x3 head, a pure MLP, cross-attention). No result is better than another, so these trials can't tell us which part limits learning. One structural point stands out: whether a placement is correct depends almost entirely on the full column profiles under its footprint. The landing layer is the maximum height under the footprint, and the brick is correct only if the target has a cell there in every covered column and no cell in the gaps below that it would seal. The dense reward also pays for sloppy large bricks, for example 3 right cells and 1 wrong. So the policy needs a precise joint function of the footprint cells. Pooled heads lose this, and narrow concatenated features may be too weak. This last round tests per-anchor MLPs on the raw concatenated column profiles, two of them aligned to the footprint and one using an anchor-agnostic window.
